item.title: github: Enterprises can now install third-party GitHub Apps
item.description:
Enterprise owners can now install public GitHub Apps built outside their enterprise on enterprise accounts. This enables third-party integrations for enterprise management scenarios.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: New enterprise installation API now in public preview
item.description:
GitHub has introduced a new Enterprise Installation API in public preview for GitHub App developers. The API fills a gap identified from community feedback and lets an app determine whether it is installed in an enterprise.

  • Source: GitHub
